system.description:
Deal [[/gmr 1d6 +@battle-status.power.attack.total ]]{ [(SR)D + (Attack Power)]} physical damage to the target.

(Effect): You gain a +1D bonus to your next [Dodge Check]. Treat this effect as a Combat Status that is removed after being applied once.

A special skill that unleashes an elegant blow from a beautiful movement. With sophisticated and efficient movements, it is possible to deal with the attack immediately after with plenty of time to spare.
